preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 10^5.
The integer k is between 1 and the length of the string s.

postconditions.description: The length of the output string is less than or equal to the length of the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] != output[i+1] for i in range(len(output) - 1))
postconditions.description: The output string does not contain any consecutive identical characters.
The output string is the result of applying the described operation any number of times to the input string s with k.
